system.description:
When you use the Force Blast Force Power, you can spend a Force Point to compare the result of your Use the Force check to the Reflex Defense of all other characters, creatures, and Droids within 2 squares of your target. If you exceed the Reflex Defense of those secondary targets, they also take damage from the Force Blast, and if you fail to exceed their Reflex Defense, they take half damage instead.

This is considered to be an Area Attack against the secondary targets (but not against the original target).
